task_completion.description: The Weasis medical viewer is open and a DICOM image is loaded in the main viewport.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible with a grayscale medical image (X-ray/CT) displayed in the center.

task_completion.description: The agent locates and opens the Look-Up Table (LUT) selection menu or panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dropdown menu or side panel containing color map options (like 'Grayscale', 'Jet', 'Hot Iron') is visible.

task_completion.description: The 'Hot Iron' pseudo-color LUT is selected and applied to the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image in the viewport changes from grayscale to a 'Hot Iron' palette (typically black, red, orange, and white tones). The 'Hot Iron' option may be highlighted in the menu.

task_completion.description: The agent opens the Export dialog and sets the format to PNG.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog box is visible with 'PNG' selected as the file format.

task_completion.description: The agent specifies the correct file path for the export.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file path field in the export dialog shows '~/DICOM/exports/colorized_ct.png' or the equivalent directory navigation is visible.

task_completion.description: The agent completes the export process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar for exporting appears, or the export dialog closes, and a file manager window might show the new file 'colorized_ct.png' in the target folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to apply the LUT rather than command-line image manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis menus and the image changing color within the application UI.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file to meet the requirement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The visual transition of the image from grayscale to 'Hot Iron' is captured in the trajectory before the export occurs.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Weasis software interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The standard Weasis toolbar, icons, and DICOM metadata overlays are visible in the screenshots.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires applying the 'Hot Iron' LUT specifically. The output must be a PNG file named 'colorized_ct.png' located in '/home/ga/DICOM/exports/'. The source image is a real DICOM file (0002.DCM) which is a multi-frame X-ray. The 'Hot Iron' LUT is characterized by a black-red-yellow-white color gradient.
